enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Stretches legs. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves arm. Adjusts blanket. Continues sleeping.

Wake up. Open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, vegetables, bread. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Cut vegetables. Crack eggs into bowl and beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker and place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs and add vegetables. Stir again. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate and put plate on table. Boil water in kettle. Pour water into teapot and add tea leaves. Pour tea into cup. Sit down and eat breakfast and drink tea. Stand up, clear dishes, wash dishes, wipe table, turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone messages and daily reminders, planning the day
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Reply to messages. Open reminder app. Check reminders. Open calendar. Review schedule. Open notes app. Write to-do list. Check weather app. Check email. Close apps. Put down phone. Pick up planner. Open planner. Write tasks. Close planner. Put down planner.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying Master of Social Work readings on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to university portal. Open reading materials. Read. Highlight text. Take notes in notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Put down pen. Scroll. Read more. Open PDF. Zoom in. Read. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Open washing machine. Sort clothes. Load clothes into washing machine. Close washing machine door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close detergent drawer. Press start button. Wait. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes into dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away. Turn off bathroom light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, tofu, rice. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Cut vegetables. Turn on rice cooker. Wash rice. Add water. Turn on rice cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables and tofu. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Place plate on table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Looking at photo of family dog and messaging family in China
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open photo gallery. Scroll to photo of dog. Look at photo. Smile. Open messaging app. Select family contact. Type message. Send message. Receive reply. Read reply. Type reply. Send reply. Look at photo again. Close messaging app. Put down phone.

Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Read instructions. Open reference materials. Type sentences. Delete sentences. Type more. Save document. Check word count. Open browser. Search for sources. Copy citation. Paste into document. Format references. Save document. Close document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a walk to manage anxiety (on foot, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Put on jacket. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Walk down street. Turn left. Walk straight. Cross road. Walk in park. Observe trees. Breathe deeply. Continue walking. Turn around. Walk back. Cross road. Walk up street. Reach home. Open door. Enter. Close door. Remove shoes. Remove jacket.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out cup. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water into cup. Add sugar. Stir. Pick up cup. Sit at table. Drink tea. Put down cup. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up cup. Drink. Put down cup. Stand up. Wash cup. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken, vegetables, rice. Close refrigerator. Prepare ingredients. Cook rice. Cook chicken and vegetables. Place food on plate. Place plate on table. Boil water. Make tea. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink tea. Stand up. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Drink water. Put down cup. Continue eating. Finish meal. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Clear dishes. Scrape food into bin. Stack plates. Carry to sink.

Stand up. Clear dishes. Scrape food into bin. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plates. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Place in drying rack. Wipe table. Wipe counters. Turn off tap. Take out trash. Tie bag. Carry to bin. Return. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open streaming service. Select show. Play. Watch. Pause. Close laptop. Turn off bedroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Planning next week and checking budget
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open planner. Review week. Write tasks. Open laptop. Open spreadsheet. Enter expenses. Calculate total. Check bank account online. Open budgeting app. Review budget. Adjust categories. Save spreadsheet. Close laptop. Close planner. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Take out cup. Place tea bag. Pour hot water. Add honey. Stir. Pick up cup. Sit at table. Drink tea. Put down cup. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up cup. Drink. Put down cup. Stand up. Wash cup. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Stretches legs. Remains still. Turns to back. Moves arm. Adjusts blanket. Continues sleeping.
